main.description: Documents and contexts the caller may read, by what they are called and what they say. Every word of the query has to be found, in any order, whatever its case. What is CALLED the query comes before what only mentions it, and that is decided before the cut at 30, so a title match is never crowded out by mentions. The text searched is a document's words, not the JSON they are stored in.

context.description: Look at the documents of one context only. Contexts themselves are then left out.
